app_store.name: Fairdeck: Slides from a Prompt
app_store.subtitle: See the price before you make
app_store.promotional_text: Out of credits? Build your deck from your own outline at no cost. Your work is never held back.
app_store.description:
Fairdeck turns an idea into a designed presentation, and shows you the price before it starts.

Type one sentence or paste your notes. Fairdeck drafts an outline you can edit, reorder and trim. Add design notes like "one idea per card", pick a theme, and the cards appear one by one.

Nothing catches you out:
- The credit cost is shown next to the button, before you make anything
- Out of credits? Build the deck from your own outline at no cost. Your work is never held back
- One switch sets the text size for the whole deck, including the PowerPoint file
- Cancel a paid plan in one click

Everything you expect:
- Edit any card: headings, lists, columns, big numbers, quotes, images
- Six themes you can switch at any time
- Present full screen with speaker notes
- Share a view-only link and see how many people opened it
- Export to PDF and PowerPoint

Start with 400 credits and a daily top-up. Solo is $8 a month for 1,000 credits. Pro is $20 a month for 2,500 credits and 40-card decks.
